representations.name: gauge-annihilating torus character lattice
representations.new_information: Stores the integral unit lattice, the kernel of all actual product-unit maps, and only characters trivial on that gauge kernel.
representations.repairs_loss: Prevents Fourier mass on harmless refactorization directions from being called Euclidean structure.
representations.first_test: Compute the exact seven-variable three-row unit matrix; any character detecting its one-dimensional gauge kernel is rejected.
representations.exponent_interface: A nontrivial observable character must either have subpower image or force full-target label growth.

representations.name: relative-unit Fourier energy at fixed X
representations.new_information: Forms Fourier energy only over unit vectors sharing the same literal common source and normalized quotient profile.
representations.repairs_loss: Excludes the moving-X translation pair and measures genuine within-fibre variation.
representations.first_test: Enumerate rational and bounded integer unit solutions of the exact block and quotient by gauge before computing support.
representations.exponent_interface: Observable Fourier support must save a fixed power or control the all-target collision fibre.

representations.name: valuation constraint matrix
representations.new_information: Records minimum and maximum exponents of every factor, quotient, source product, complement product and common mask as affine functions of unit variables.
representations.repairs_loss: Turns independent Newton widths into an exact simultaneous translation system.
representations.first_test: Row-reduce the fixed-X equations and identify free directions; kill any width theorem that counts the gauge variable.
representations.exponent_interface: A bounded polytope for the observable quotient could give a subpower unit count.

representations.name: Newton-face compatibility fan
representations.new_information: Decorates each valuation chamber by which extremal coefficients survive in both positive products and by target tangent-square ordering.
representations.repairs_loss: Can detect observable unit wall crossings rather than only invariant factor widths.
representations.first_test: Move along the exact gauge line; every Newton face and target order must remain constant.
representations.exponent_interface: Only wall crossings changing an actual distance fibre may contribute to a gain.

representations.name: unit-to-distance collision energy map
representations.new_information: Maps each fixed-X observable unit class to the exact target-target radical-label multiplicity distribution.
representations.repairs_loss: Tests directly whether unit entropy changes the collision graph.
representations.first_test: Sample many exact gauge representatives; raw unit variation must give identical energy and labels.
representations.exponent_interface: A positive-rank observable family needs either a uniform label lower bound or an energy fibre below 1/9-epsilon.

representations.name: relative-unit additive quadruple ledger
representations.new_information: Counts additive relations among observable product units together with exact equalities among squarefree-radical distance labels.
representations.repairs_loss: Separates algebraic unit coincidences from actual geometric collision fibres.
representations.first_test: The gauge line has maximal raw additive energy but constant geometry; reject raw-energy inverse claims.
representations.exponent_interface: An inverse theorem must operate on the gauge quotient and propagate to all targets.

representations.name: projective monomial gauge slice
representations.new_information: Fixes one factor unit, for example u(G), and solves all remaining units from identities and fixed-X observable products.
representations.repairs_loss: Provides a canonical representative when the only free direction is simultaneous refactorization.
representations.first_test: Prove uniqueness of the representative in the exact three-row block and verify all distances are gauge invariant.
representations.exponent_interface: A uniform bounded-index gauge slice reduces raw fibres to observable fibres without loss.

representations.name: Smith-normal-form unit quotient
representations.new_information: Computes rank and torsion of the integer quotient of unit variables by identity, fixed-source and fixed-complement constraints.
representations.repairs_loss: Distinguishes a continuous gauge line, finite torsion choices and genuine observable translations.
representations.first_test: The exact block should have raw kernel rank one and observable quotient rank zero with no torsion.
representations.exponent_interface: Uniform rank zero and subpower torsion would prove subpower observable unit fibres.

representations.name: conditional unit entropy decomposition
representations.new_information: Decomposes raw entropy into common-X, gauge, observable-unit and normalized-profile terms.
representations.repairs_loss: Forbids charging infinite or power-large gauge entropy to distance labels.
representations.first_test: On bounded gauge samples raw entropy grows while observable entropy is exactly zero.
representations.exponent_interface: Only observable conditional entropy may enter a row-saving or fibre estimate.

representations.name: unit wall-crossing entropy versus labels
representations.new_information: Counts distinct target-order and collision chambers reached by fixed-X observable units rather than the number of unit representatives.
representations.repairs_loss: A continuum inside one collision chamber is counted once.
representations.first_test: The exact gauge line must occupy one chamber despite infinitely many rational representatives.
representations.exponent_interface: Power-many observable chambers must yield a uniform distance gain or contradict paired-positive capacity.
